# Jumia Nigeria

> > Africa's leading e-commerce platform offering millions of products across electronics, fashion, home goods, and more with secure JumiaPay payment integration.

Jumia Nigeria is the #1 online shopping marketplace in Nigeria, featuring over 700,000 products across multiple categories including smartphones, fashion, home appliances, and electronics. The platform integrates JumiaPay for secure transactions and serves as a comprehensive retail destination for Nigerian consumers.

## Key Topics

- Nigeria e-commerce marketplace
- Online shopping platform
- Product catalog
- Electronics & appliances
- Fashion & clothing
- JumiaPay payment
- Price comparison
- Discount deals
- Android & smart devices
- Samsung & TCL brands
- WiFi & Bluetooth connectivity
- Mobile phones & tablets
- Home & kitchen products
- Health & beauty
- Gaming & consoles

## Shopping Categories

- [Jumia Nigeria Homepage](https://www.jumia.com.ng): Jumia Nigeria homepage - #1 online shopping marketplace with multiple categories
- [Fashion Products](https://www.jumia.com.ng/category-fashion-by-jumia): Fashion marketplace with 225855 items: ADIDAS, sneakers, mens/womens wear
- [Phones & Tablets](https://www.jumia.com.ng/phones-tablets): Mobile devices marketplace with 141457 phones and tablets, Android 13+
- [Health & Beauty](https://www.jumia.com.ng/health-beauty): Health & beauty products with NIVEA, Eucerin, and 174627 items available
- [Home & Kitchen Products](https://www.jumia.com.ng/home-office): Home and kitchen products including generators, solar items, 172914 listings
- [Electronics Store](https://www.jumia.com.ng/electronics): Electronics store with 45878 products: smart TVs, LED TVs, and tech items
- [Home Appliances](https://www.jumia.com.ng/mlp-appliances): Home appliances catalog with 45000+ products from Royal, Maxi, Goldcrown
- [Computing & IT Accessories](https://www.jumia.com.ng/computing): Computing devices with ASUS VIVOBOOK, Intel processors, 51849 IT products
